en: Black‑and‑white landscape postcard showing a hilly, wooded area with scattered villas and larger buildings. On the right hillside stands an ornate multi‑storey building with towers, likely a historic hotel or sanatorium, and on the far right a small tower is visible on the ridge. In the foreground are houses, trees, and what appear to be vineyards. The image is framed by a white border with a caption printed at the bottom.
